title: Market the property for sale
summary: Prepare the offering package and data room, run the marketing, and manage tours and offers.
outlineSteps: Name the likely buyers for the property's type and stage
Normalize the NOI and source every market claim
Assemble the data room: rent roll, leases, contracts, statements and reports
Review the offering package before it goes out
Set the marketing timeline and the offer date
Release the package to buyers who sign the confidentiality agreement
Run tours with the tenant notice the leases require
Answer buyer questions in one log shared with every bidder
Collect offers on a common form
Summarize the offers for the decision makers
